backend/main.mo: Motoko canister that stores cutoff records, imports them from CSV, filters by candidature, computes predicted ranks, and exposes query/mutation methods including prediction and range retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing a UI feature update ensuring only eligible prediction results are shown, referencing affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files including app entry, predictor page, styling, and Tailwind config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes with warm earth‑tone palette and global background/text styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML root document setting up the app container and loading the main React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Minimal wrapper component that renders the predictor form page inside a full‑height themed container.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and provider implementing Internet Identity login, identity persistence, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS variables and global styles using warm education‑themed colors and font feature settings for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point mounting the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Main predictor UI handling percentile input, candidature selection, CSV cutoff import, backend prediction calls, and rendering the filtered eligible‑college results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme settings for fonts, colors, radii, shadows, animations, and includes typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, feature set, and pending requests related to filtering cutoff records based on predicted_rank <= closing_rank.
